propertyNames pattern: one-letter and upper-case codes are refused
maxLength counts code points, not bytes

cases.comment: 1.0 is an integer (JSON Schema 2020-12); written as a raw literal
1e400 is not a finite number (JSON.parse gives Infinity, which ajv accepts as an integer: Go is stricter, so this case is Go only)
a half-filled page link saves as draft
required page_id is reported at the missing field
an empty link saves as draft
only type is reported (neither if matches)
not: a page link must not carry url
not: a url link must not carry page_id
not: a url link must not carry anchor
http:// is not allowed by the schema pattern
a bare relative path is not a site path
R-016: /\host is read as //host by browsers
type object; the presence-only not still matches a non-object (required is vacuous), as in ajv
else branch: cards required only in publish
then: required album_id skipped in draft
required inside array items skipped in draft
group_key has no pattern in the schema
no text node = empty in the default locale
a blank text node is empty
additionalProperties is open on the doc in the schema; Go refuses it (allow-list)
schema maxItems 50 on content; Go adds the node-count issue
KnownLocales = {la,en}: a code that is not in cms_locales
minLength is not enforced in draft
minProperties is not enforced in draft
required inside not is a condition, never relaxed: the schema is NOT edited in draft
an empty object does not match the not subschema
required inside if decides the branch in draft
uniqueItems on objects ignores key order
a required localized leaf inside an array item
a leaf required by an applied then is checked too
